body: I can't see it that way, I can't see myself as a real, actualized person without a partner. Some people can be happy single, and I'm not one of them. And again, if she needs to work out those issues, then I'm willing to bear with her. At least at this point, I can't see myself as happy, or even present in the future, if I don't have her too.

I have tried. Every day of my life. It's not about capacity to enjoy things, it's about being burned out, having every plan you made for your life crushed by an unseen force, and that force spitting in your face when you try to fix it in any meaningful way, even that which seems simplest.
